# Miriam Grijota Chousa

Miriam Grijota Chousa is a biostatistician who serves as the statistician and data manager (Statistiker/Datamanager) for [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), Denmark's national quality database for atrial fibrillation care[^src1]. She is identified in the source documents as "Biostatistiker RKKP," meaning her employer is [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), the organization that runs Denmark's regional clinical quality improvement programs[^src2].

Her name appears in the steering group listings of two consecutive AFDK annual reports. The first is the report covering 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, where chapters 5–7 describe the database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the composition of the steering group[^src1]. The second is the report covering the following year, in a section (pages 66–70) that documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has run systematic patient education since 2012, and lists the steering group's members alongside key methodological limitations of the database[^src2]. In both reports, her role is consistently listed as biostatistician for RKKP, underscoring her continuing function as the technical data-management link within AFDK's steering structure, which operates as a nationwide quality database under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and with the Sundhedsstyrelsen's approval[^src2].

No further biographical or professional details about Miriam Grijota Chousa are provided in the corpus.
